svg.title: Speedup of each hotkernels kernel over NumPy
svg.desc: Horizontal bars, two per NumPy call, showing how many times faster the kernel is than NumPy 2.5.5 on arrays of 1,048,576 elements: on an Apple M1 Pro and on an Intel Core i5-14600KF. The values are in the table that follows the chart in the README.

g.text: Speedup over NumPy, kernel by kernel
Times faster than NumPy 2.5.5 on arrays of 1,048,576 elements, timed as native functions. Logarithmic scale.
darker: in the more favourable case only
